long_biography.plain_text:
Ingvall grew up sailing in the Finnish archipelago and progressed through dinghy classes before entering international ocean racing. After competing as crew in one Whitbread Round the World Race, he skippered Finland's entry in the following edition. He later won the Fastnet Race, claimed maxi-class world titles and set a transatlantic monohull record, building campaigns around specialist crews, commercial sponsorship and technical experimentation.

His career later centered increasingly on Australia, where he twice took Sydney-to-Hobart line honours, in 2000 and 2004. He later returned with redesigned racing projects and continued competing in Scandinavian and Australian events. Beyond the helm, he has described himself as a company director and business investor. He has also mentored younger sailors through his racing programme. As a Sydney-based Team Finland ambassador, he promoted Finnish businesses and commercial ties in Australia.
